note: Happily Ever After V2: characters share the spotlight (docs/shows/happily-ever-after/V2-PLAN.md). An overlay on happily-ever-after.json's scenes, by title, read by display/fireworks/score.py when config.json's show_version is "v2". Per scene, each optional: stage (castle, ghost: dimmed for characters to stand in front of, off: gone), actors (display/fireworks/show_actors.ACTORS), rate (replaces the scene's), note.

Down in New Orleans (prologue).note: Ray loops a figure-eight by the evening star

When You Wish Upon a Star (fanfare).note: Ray drifts over and circles the spire

Touch the Sky.note: fewer fireworks, so her arrow shows; Merida says her line at the bottom left, then on "touch the sky" shoots an arrow into a bullseye firework (64x64)

Princess garden.note: four couples meet in turn, a heart floating up between each

Touch the Sky / Up.note: Carl's house rises from behind the castle on its balloons

How Far I'll Go (climax).note: Moana's canoe sails across once the castle goes

You've Got a Friend in Me.note: Buzz flies across, Woody waves from the ground

Friendship mash-up.note: Ralph smashes bricks (0-14 s in), Baymax inflates and waves (15-22), Joy's and Sadness's memory orbs (35-54)

That's What Friends Are For.note: Mike peeks over the left turret, then the right

Friend Like Me (Genie).note: Genie circles the spire; half V1's fireworks, so bursts don't sit on him

Friend Like Me (finale).note: he sings on to 563, round the full castle and its fountains

Olaf: some people are worth melting for.note: Olaf pops up and waves in the snow

I See the Light.note: Rapunzel and Flynn's boat drifts in among the lanterns

I See the Light (lanterns).note: she lets her own lantern go

Embers.note: Mufasa's face fades in among the stars over the spire

You'll Be in My Heart.note: Dumbo flies across, flapping his ears
